item.title: Version 1.1
item.description:
Textlore 1.1: Recs and Promises, and WhatsApp

A free update with the two things people asked for most. Your friends tell you what to try, and you tell them what you'll do. Textlore now remembers both for you.

Recs

Every book, show, film, restaurant, place, podcast, song and app a friend told you to try, in one place. You can see who said it, when, and their own words. Things more than one friend recommended come first. Mark them as tried as you go.

Promises

Every "I'll send it tomorrow" and "kal pakka bhej dunga" you wrote, with who it was for and the day you said. Textlore shows what's past its day, what's coming up, and what looks done. A short weekly note says how many are still open (numbers only, so nothing private shows on your lock screen), and you can set a reminder for any one of them. Textlore never sends a message for you.

WhatsApp

Textlore can now read your WhatsApp for Mac chats as well as Messages, if you say yes. They show up in your conversations, search, Your Lore, Ask AI, and Recs and Promises.

How it works

  • Apple Intelligence reads your chats on your Mac. Nothing goes to a server.
  • The first read starts on its own, newest messages first. On a long history it can take a few hours, and it's fastest with the Mac plugged in. You can keep using Textlore while it works.
  • Recs and Promises need a Mac with Apple Intelligence. WhatsApp works on every Mac.

Textlore is not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta. Everything stays on your Mac, and Textlore only reads.
